search_unit: READERSHIP x READING_MOTIVATION x BOOK_MARKET x READER_PROMISE x DISCOVERY_CHANNEL
priority_order: relatively easy production at required reader quality
ranking: Commercial tier descending, then production effort ascending; only eligible candidates. No additive ease bonus.

commercial_tiers.STRONG: Corroborated relevant demand plus convincing evidence of reachable entry for a comparable new title, supported economics and explicit uncertainties. Fame-driven sales alone cannot establish this tier.
commercial_tiers.MODERATE: Corroborated comparable demand and supported entry/economics, but material uncertainty remains.
commercial_tiers.WEAK: Category interest or isolated purchases with inadequate entry/economics evidence.
commercial_tiers.UNKNOWN: Insufficient observations; never infer zero demand.

evidence_rules: At least two independent origins support comparable book purchases or dated traction proxies; explain proxy limits and source independence.
Reader choice may rest on genre experience, voice, audience, topic, language, curation, design or explanation; no mandatory novel mechanism or unsolved practical problem.
Claims cover book demand, reader choice, reachability and unit economics; unknown costs or acquisition assumptions remain explicit.
Source kinds and tiers are researcher judgments to audit, not automatic truth or invented unit sales.

fresh_demand_sensor.role: Optional nomination and language sensor before market validation
allowed_signals: recent Amazon prices, ratings and written-review samples when its opt-in Amazon lane is configured
fresh_demand_sensor.evidence_boundary: Attention, engagement, requests, prediction-market activity, ratings and reviews do not by themselves establish book purchases, newcomer reachability or unit economics.
fresh_demand_sensor.admission_rule: Promote a nomination to a market card only after separate book-market evidence is collected and source independence is checked.

production_rules: Estimate drafting, editorial revision, fact checking, illustrations, rights, layout, owner time and ongoing updates.
Fiction needs narrative and genre-quality review; business needs credible substantiation; visual and children books need appropriate art/pedagogy review.
Low word count or quick AI drafting does not prove easy production.
A hard delivery/rights constraint may exclude a commercially strong concept but must not relabel its demand as weak.
scope: New concepts only; no portfolio listing audit or Monday schedule changes.
RN9-001 remains historical; prototype instruction deferred by current user direction.
No production, publication or paid research authorized.
